call_logging_exceptions: call a behavior function and log any exceptions it raises, returning an Outcome
with_exceptions_logged: wrap a callable so exceptions are logged and an Outcome is returned instead
Outcome_Kind: inspect the Outcome.Kind enum to check if a call returned a value or raised an exception
Outcome_return_value: access the return_value attribute of an Outcome to get the value returned by a successful call
Outcome_exception: access the exception attribute of an Outcome to get the exception raised by a failed call
